propositions: REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY inline-PEM source is read into OpcertServiceConfig but never removed from os.environ, leaving the raw key visible to child processes and environment dumps after config load
The secret remains in os.environ for child process inheritance by ssh-keygen and git, which do not override env explicitly
OpcertServiceConfig.from_env() is the sole reader and caller at module scope in app.py, invoked once per process with no reload path
Consuming the variable via os.environ.pop() inside _private_key_env() transfers the secret to cfg.private_key and removes it from the process environment boundary
A second from_env() call in the same process must yield private_key is None to pin consume-once contract and prevent silent regression if reload is added later
The hardening narrows the exposure window in dev/compat inline-PEM path but does not erase the secret from memory, core dumps, or platform credential records
